name: Literally Just A Girl Tee
note:
A white oversized tee with a small burgundy chest statement and a plain back. The restrained print leaves plenty of clean space around the lettering. Wear it loose or tuck it into your favourite jeans.

240 GSM, 100% super-combed cotton. Pre-shrunk and bio-washed, with a Lycra-ribbed neckline and double-stitched construction. Full-length, unisex oversized fit.
